answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the crystal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vertex re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the orchard of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
